title: Gudea of Sumer given temple plans in a dream

tellings.quote: King Judaea of Sumeria saying that in a dream he was given this lapis lazuli,

plain: An ancient king of Sumer, the early civilisation of what is now Iraq, is said to have written that in a dream he was given lapis lazuli, a deep blue stone, along with the plans for a temple. Michels brings this up himself, calling the king "Judaea" (the name in the record is Gudea), alongside other ancient rulers he names, Thutmose IV and Nebuchadnezzar. He tells it as an example of great buildings said to have been planned from visions.
